title: Stoneridge Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Continued Sales Momentum and Cost Discipline Highlight 3Q ProgressNOVI, Mich., Nov. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Stoneridge, Inc. (NYSE: SRI) today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. 2026 Third Quarter Highlights:Continued sales growth and commercial momentum:Reported Q3 sales growth of 12.4% YoY to $155.8 million, which reflects a $24.2 million reduction
